title: Continual Distillation Learning for Rehearsal-Free Class-Incremental Learning via Decoupled Prompting
abstract: arXiv:2407.13911v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prompt-based continual learning has shown strong performance in rehearsal-free class-incremental learning by adapting learnable prompts while freezing a pre-trained Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone. However, the effect of backbone scale remains underexplored. We observe that larger ViT backbones consistently yield better continual learning performance, which motivates us to study how to transfer such capability from a larger model to a smaller one. In this paper, we introduce Continual Distillation Learning (CDL), a new setting for knowledge distillation in rehearsal-free prompt-based continual learning. We show that conventional distillation methods provide only limited gains in CDL, mainly because task-specific prompts are forced to encode both continual adaptation and distillation knowledge, while lacking a persistent mechanism for cross-task knowledge transfer. To address this problem, we propose Decoupled Continual Distil

translated_title: 无重放类增量学习中的持续蒸馏学习：基于解耦提示的方法
translated_abstract: 基于提示的持续学习通过在冻结预训练视觉Transformer（ViT）主干的同时调整可学习提示，在无重放的类增量学习中展现了强大性能。然而，主干规模的影响仍未得到充分探索。我们观察到，更大的ViT主干持续带来更好的持续学习性能，这促使我们研究如何将这种能力从较大模型转移到较小模型。在本文中，我们引入了持续蒸馏学习（CDL），这是一种用于无重放基于提示的持续学习中的知识蒸馏新设置。我们表明，传统蒸馏方法在CDL中仅提供有限的改进，主要原因是任务特定提示被迫同时编码持续适应和蒸馏知识，而缺乏跨任务知识转移的持久机制。为解决此问题，我们提出了解耦持续蒸馏方法。
tldr: 本文提出持续蒸馏学习（CDL）设置和解耦持续蒸馏方法，通过解耦任务特定提示中的适应与蒸馏知识，实现无重放类增量学习中从大模型到小模型的有效知识转移。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Continual Distillation Learning (CDL) and a decoupled distillation method that separates adaptation and distillation knowledge in task-specific prompts, enabling effective knowledge transfer from large to small models in rehearsal-free class-incremental learning.
